title_english: Traditional Tai Wisdom and Counsel to Noble Daughters
description: Ancient instructional manuscript containing moral advice, household management, weaving artistry, and spiritual virtue for Tai women.
source_archive: SEAlang Library / Stephen Morey Archive (Tai Manuscripts of Assam)

units.text_roman: na1 ta1 phak1
units.lik_tai: ၼႃ တႃ ၽၵ်
units.assamese_script: না¹ তা¹ ফাক্‌¹
units.translation: Blessings.
units.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Blessings.

units.text_roman: maɯ2 naang2 khjn2 waai1 tang1 naa3 maa2 khaan1 khuu1
units.lik_tai: မႇ ၼႃင်ႇ ၶၼ်ႇ ဝႃႆ တင် ၼႃႈ မႃႇ ၶႃၼ် ၶ
units.assamese_script: ম² নাঙ² খন² ৱাই¹ তাঙ¹ না³ মা² খান¹ খ¹
units.translation: Dear lady, please turn your face, with a smile and laugh.
units.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Dear lady, please turn your face, with a smile and laugh.

units.text_roman: khaam2 nii2 sii1 tsuu3 sɯn1 sɯn1 ta1
units.lik_tai: ၶႃမ်ႇ ၼႇ ꩢ ၸႈ ꩢိုၼ် ꩢိုၼ် တႃ
units.assamese_script: খাম² ন² স¹ চ³ সুন¹ সুন¹ তা¹
units.translation: There are four types of the good words of Dharma.
units.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: There are four types of the good words of Dharma.

units.text_roman: kau2 tak1 lau2 maɯ2 naang2 hit1 ruu3 ki3 saɯ1 naang2 ɯi2
units.lik_tai: ၵဝ်ႇ တၵ် လဝ်ႇ မႇ ၼႃင်ႇ ႁိတ် ရႈ ၵိႈ ꩢ ၼႃင်ႇ ဢိုႆႇ
units.assamese_script: কাও² তাক্‌¹ লাও² ম² নাঙ² হিত্‌¹ ৰ³ কি³ স¹ নাঙ² অুই²
units.translation: I will tell you, my lady, so that you may know them and put them in (your mind), oh lady!
units.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: I will tell you, my lady, so that you may know them and put them in (your mind), oh lady!

units.text_roman: an2 waa2 khaam2 nui3 mɯng2 kuu2 nai3 k3 sii1 lak1
units.lik_tai: ဢၼ်ႇ ဝႃႇ ၶႃမ်ႇ ၼုႆႈ မိုင်ႇ ၵႇ ၼႆႈ ၵႈ ꩢ လၵ်
units.assamese_script: অন² ৱা² খাম² নুই³ মুঙ² ক² নাই³ ক³ স¹ লাক্‌¹
units.translation: I will tell these words for the whole earth, for all the four parts, oh my lady.
units.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: I will tell these words for the whole earth, for all the four parts, oh my lady.

units.text_roman: kau2 tsau3 tak1 lau2 haɯ2 naang2 nai3
units.lik_tai: ၵဝ်ႇ ၸဝ်ႈ တၵ် လဝ်ႇ ႁႇ ၼႃင်ႇ ၼႆႈ
units.assamese_script: কাও² চাও³ তাক্‌¹ লাও² হ² নাঙ² নাই³
units.translation: I will tell so that you can listen.
units.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: I will tell so that you can listen.

units.text_roman: naang2 tsang1 waai1 naa3 tang3 naa3
units.lik_tai: ၼႃင်ႇ ၸင် ဝႃႆ ၼႃႈ တင်ႈ ၼႃႈ
units.assamese_script: নাঙ² চাঙ¹ ৱাই¹ না³ তাঙ³ না³
units.translation: Lady, turn your face and gaze.
units.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Lady, turn your face and gaze.

units.text_roman: maa2 khan1
units.lik_tai: မႃႇ ၶၼ်
units.assamese_script: মা² খান¹
units.translation: Come quickly.
units.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Come quickly.

units.text_roman: phum1 sng1 tin2 nk3 tsau3
units.lik_tai: ၽုမ် ꩢင် တိၼ်ႇ ၼၵ်ႈ ၸဝ်ႈ
units.assamese_script: ফুম¹ সঙ¹ তিন² নক্‌³ চাও³
units.translation: From top to toe we make our prayers.
units.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: From top to toe we make our prayers.

units.text_roman: kau2 khun1 tak1 lau2 khaam2 tɯ2 ta1 ta1
units.lik_tai: ၵဝ်ႇ ၶုၼ် တၵ် လဝ်ႇ ၶႃမ်ႇ တိုႇ တႃ တႃ
units.assamese_script: কাও² খুন¹ তাক্‌¹ লাও² খাম² তু² তা¹ তা¹
units.translation: I will tell the words of Dharma.
units.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: I will tell the words of Dharma.

units.text_roman: haɯ3 naang2 ruu3 sjn1 sing1 ta1
units.lik_tai: ႁႈ ၼႃင်ႇ ရႈ ꩢၼ် ꩢိင် တႃ
units.assamese_script: হ³ নাঙ² ৰ³ সন¹ সিঙ¹ তা¹
units.translation: So that the lady may know the many sounds of the Dharma, think oh Lady!
units.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: So that the lady may know the many sounds of the Dharma, think oh Lady!

units.text_roman: tang1 nii2 tang1 kin2 k3 mau1 tsut3 raai1
units.lik_tai: တင် ၼႇ တင် ၵိၼ်ႇ ၵႈ မဝ် ၸုတ်ႈ ရႃႆ
units.assamese_script: তাঙ¹ ন² তাঙ¹ কিন² ক³ মাও¹ চুত্‌³ ৰাই¹
units.translation: (For in this Dharma), all is good, there is much to eat, and none are poor.
units.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: (For in this Dharma), all is good, there is much to eat, and none are poor.

units.text_roman: tang1 kaa1 khng1 kin2 tsam3 yaa1 lɯk3 sju3
units.lik_tai: တင် ၵႃ ၶင် ၵိၼ်ႇ ၸမ်ႈ ယႃ လိုၵ်ႈ ꩢႈ
units.assamese_script: তাঙ¹ কা¹ খঙ¹ কিন² চাম³ যা¹ লুক্‌³ স³
units.translation: Of all the things which are offered to eat, do not choose, but take all.
units.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Of all the things which are offered to eat, do not choose, but take all.

units.text_roman: tang1 wan2 tang1 khɯn2 kau2 thɯng1 phaa3 ta1 ta1
units.lik_tai: တင် ဝၼ်ႇ တင် ၶိုၼ်ႇ ၵဝ်ႇ ထိုင် ၽႃႈ တႃ တႃ
units.assamese_script: তাঙ¹ ৱান² তাঙ¹ খুন² কাও² থুঙ¹ ফা³ তা¹ তা¹
units.translation: Both day and night I reach reach towards God, towards Dharma and the teaching.
units.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Both day and night I reach reach towards God, towards Dharma and the teaching.

units.text_roman: tang1 khau1 nai3 khau1 au2 tsam3
units.lik_tai: တင် ၶဝ် ၼႆႈ ၶဝ် ဢဝ်ႇ ၸမ်ႈ
units.assamese_script: তাঙ¹ খাও¹ নাই³ খাও¹ ঔ² চাম³
units.translation: All of this should be taken, don't just read it, put it into your mind.
units.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: All of this should be taken, don't just read it, put it into your mind.

units.text_roman: an2 naɯ2 tak1 tsaa3 tsam3 yaa1 haɯ3 maa2
units.lik_tai: ဢၼ်ႇ ၼႇ တၵ် ၸႃႈ ၸမ်ႈ ယႃ ႁႈ မႃႇ
units.assamese_script: অন² ন² তাক্‌¹ চা³ চাম³ যা¹ হ³ মা²
units.translation: Allow (the Dharma) to touch all of your body, Oh Lady!
units.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Allow (the Dharma) to touch all of your body, Oh Lady!

units.text_roman: an2 tak1 saa1 tak1 nan3 tsam3 yaa1 laat3 png1
units.lik_tai: ဢၼ်ႇ တၵ် ꩢႃ တၵ် ၼၼ်ႈ ၸမ်ႈ ယႃ လႃတ်ႈ ပင်
units.assamese_script: অন² তাক্‌¹ সা¹ তাক্‌¹ নান³ চাম³ যা¹ লাত্‌³ পঙ¹
units.translation: Let the good come and do not speak words of complaint.
units.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Let the good come and do not speak words of complaint.

units.text_roman: kaa3 maɯ2 naang2 yaa1 pui1 kaau1
units.lik_tai: ၵႃႈ မႇ ၼႃင်ႇ ယႃ ပုႆ ၵႃဝ်
units.assamese_script: কা³ ম² নাঙ² যা¹ পুই¹ কাও¹
units.translation: Oh lady, you should not ask for the help of spirits, you should not let bad things enter your mind.
units.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Oh lady, you should not ask for the help of spirits, you should not let bad things enter your mind.

units.text_roman: an2 hit1 kuu2 tsng3 nai3 k3 maɯ2 naang2
units.lik_tai: ဢၼ်ႇ ႁိတ် ၵႇ ၸင်ႈ ၼႆႈ ၵႈ မႇ ၼႃင်ႇ
units.assamese_script: অন² হিত্‌¹ ক² চঙ³ নাই³ ক³ ম² নাঙ²
units.translation: All types of bad action, oh lady, you should not do.
units.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: All types of bad action, oh lady, you should not do.

units.text_roman: khaam2 sui3 yaa1 tɯ2 t1 naa3 naang2 ɯi2
units.assamese_script: খাম² সুই³ যা¹ তু² ত¹ না³ নাঙ² অুই²
units.translation: Do not speak jealous words, oh Lady!
units.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Do not speak jealous words, oh Lady!

units.text_roman: khaam2 naa1 khaam2 t2 pɯn2 tsam3 yaa1 laat3 png1
units.lik_tai: ၶႃမ်ႇ ၼႃ ၶႃမ်ႇ တႇ ပိုၼ်ႇ ၸမ်ႈ ယႃ လႃတ်ႈ ပင်
units.assamese_script: খাম² না¹ খাম² ত² পুন² চাম³ যা¹ লাত্‌³ পঙ¹
units.translation: Do not speaking abusive or fighting words, and do not complain.
units.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Do not speaking abusive or fighting words, and do not complain.

units.text_roman: khaam2 an2 nj2 maɯ1 pɯn2 nam1 maa2 nang1 nai3 tsam3
units.lik_tai: ၶႃမ်ႇ ဢၼ်ႇ ၼႇ မ ပိုၼ်ႇ ၼမ် မႃႇ ၼင် ၼႆႈ ၸမ်ႈ
units.assamese_script: খাম² অন² ন² ম¹ পুন² নাম¹ মা² নাঙ¹ নাই³ চাম³
units.translation: Words of censuring others like this should not be spoken, oh my Lady!
units.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Words of censuring others like this should not be spoken, oh my Lady!

units.text_roman: khaam2 tsaa3 nai3 tsam3 maɯ2 naang2
units.lik_tai: ၶႃမ်ႇ ၸႃႈ ၼႆႈ ၸမ်ႈ မႇ ၼႃင်ႇ
units.assamese_script: খাম² চা³ নাই³ চাম³ ম² নাঙ²
units.translation: Though bad words may come, oh Lady, leave them aside every day.
units.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Though bad words may come, oh Lady, leave them aside every day.

units.text_roman: sang1 phaɯ1 phit1 lung1 k3 maɯ2 naang2 khaɯ3 thɯng1
units.lik_tai: ꩢင် ၽ ၽိတ် လုင် ၵႈ မႇ ၼႃင်ႇ ၶႈ ထိုင်
units.assamese_script: সাঙ¹ ফ¹ ফিত্‌¹ লুঙ¹ ক³ ম² নাঙ² খ³ থুঙ¹
units.translation: If someone does wrong, oh lady, think well.
units.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: If someone does wrong, oh lady, think well.

units.text_roman: yaa1 hit1 luu3 naa3 naang2 ɯi2
units.assamese_script: যা¹ হিত্‌¹ ল³ না³ নাঙ² অুই²
units.translation: Don't do anything destructive, oh lady!
units.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Don't do anything destructive, oh lady!

units.text_roman: kuu2 wan2 k3 maɯ2 naang2 khaɯ3
units.lik_tai: ၵႇ ဝၼ်ႇ ၵႈ မႇ ၼႃင်ႇ ၶႈ
units.assamese_script: ক² ৱান² ক³ ম² নাঙ² খ³
units.translation: Every day, Oh lady, you should think and speak diamond words, listen, oh my Lady!
units.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Every day, Oh lady, you should think and speak diamond words, listen, oh my Lady!

units.text_roman: maɯ2 naang2 rɯ1 tak1 sau2 yɯn2 tsuk1 naa3
units.lik_tai: မႇ ၼႃင်ႇ ရို တၵ် ꩢဝ်ႇ ယိုၼ်ႇ ၸုၵ် ၼႃႈ
units.assamese_script: ম² নাঙ² ৰু¹ তাক্‌¹ সাও² যুন² চুক্‌¹ না³
units.translation: Oh you lady, how will you remain cool (headed)?
units.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Oh you lady, how will you remain cool (headed)?

units.text_roman: tsam3 maɯ2 naang2 tɯ2 tang1 khaam2 ta1 ta1
units.lik_tai: ၸမ်ႈ မႇ ၼႃင်ႇ တိုႇ တင် ၶႃမ်ႇ တႃ တႃ
units.assamese_script: চাম³ ম² নাঙ² তু² তাঙ¹ খাম² তা¹ তা¹
units.translation: If, oh my lady, you hold all the words of Dharma and do not release them, it will be good, oh Lady!
units.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: If, oh my lady, you hold all the words of Dharma and do not release them, it will be good, oh Lady!

units.text_roman: pi2 khai2 nuu2 khai2 aan1 k3
units.lik_tai: ပိႇ ၶႆႇ ၼႇ ၶႆႇ ဢႃၼ် ၵႈ
units.assamese_script: পি² খাই² ন² খাই² আন¹ ক³
units.translation: You should look at and read the words of Dharma, all of them, oh Lady.
units.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: You should look at and read the words of Dharma, all of them, oh Lady.

units.text_roman: an2 naɯ1 tak1 nii2 tsam3 maɯ2 naang2 laak1 sju3
units.lik_tai: ဢၼ်ႇ ၼ တၵ် ၼႇ ၸမ်ႈ မႇ ၼႃင်ႇ လႃၵ် ꩢႈ
units.assamese_script: অন² ন¹ তাক্‌¹ ন² চাম³ ম² নাঙ² লাক্‌¹ স³
units.translation: Oh, it will be good, my Lady, if you catch (this Dharma).
units.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Oh, it will be good, my Lady, if you catch (this Dharma).

units.text_roman: maɯ2 laak1 au2 khaam2 ta1 ta1 yaa1 phwaa3
units.lik_tai: မႇ လႃၵ် ဢဝ်ႇ ၶႃမ်ႇ တႃ တႃ ယႃ ၽႂႃႈ
units.assamese_script: ম² লাক্‌¹ ঔ² খাম² তা¹ তা¹ যা¹ ফ্বা³
units.translation: If you take the words of Dharma, do not release them.
units.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: If you take the words of Dharma, do not release them.

units.text_roman: naɯ2 tsaɯ2 maɯ2 naang2 sng1 yaa1 tsam3 naang2 ɯi2
units.lik_tai: ၼႇ ၸႇ မႇ ၼႃင်ႇ ꩢင် ယႃ ၸမ်ႈ ၼႃင်ႇ ဢိုႆႇ
units.assamese_script: ন² চ² ম² নাঙ² সঙ¹ যা¹ চাম³ নাঙ² অুই²
units.translation: Put them clearly in your mind, without blemish.
units.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Put them clearly in your mind, without blemish.

units.text_roman: p2 nang1 nam3 sjn1 khj2 lai1 png1
units.lik_tai: ပႇ ၼင် ၼမ်ႈ ꩢၼ် ၶႇ လႆ ပင်
units.assamese_script: প² নাঙ¹ নাম³ সন¹ খ² লাই¹ পঙ¹
units.translation: Like the water of many river, (the Dharma) will flow into your mind, like a clear spirit.
units.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Like the water of many river, (the Dharma) will flow into your mind, like a clear spirit.

units.text_roman: sjn1 khun1 phaɯ1 nai3 pai2 aap1 maa2 lau2
units.lik_tai: ꩢၼ် ၶုၼ် ၽ ၼႆႈ ပႆႇ ဢႃပ် မႃႇ လဝ်ႇ
units.assamese_script: সন¹ খুন¹ ফ¹ নাই³ পাই² আপ্‌¹ মা² লাও²
units.translation: Those many people who (accept the Dharma) will be as bathed in it many times, oh good lady.
units.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Those many people who (accept the Dharma) will be as bathed in it many times, oh good lady.

units.text_roman: t1 maɯ2 naang2 yaa1 pui1 kaau1 lai3 maa2 png1
units.lik_tai: တ မႇ ၼႃင်ႇ ယႃ ပုႆ ၵႃဝ် လႆႈ မႃႇ ပင်
units.assamese_script: ত¹ ম² নাঙ² যা¹ পুই¹ কাও¹ লাই³ মা² পঙ¹
units.translation: Oh my lady, do not pray to the spirits, and all will become clear.
units.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Oh my lady, do not pray to the spirits, and all will become clear.

units.text_roman: maɯ2 naang2 laak1 kaau1 taang1 phaa3 ta1
units.lik_tai: မႇ ၼႃင်ႇ လႃၵ် ၵႃဝ် တႃင် ၽႃႈ တႃ
units.assamese_script: ম² নাঙ² লাক্‌¹ কাও¹ তাঙ¹ ফা³ তা¹
units.translation: Oh my lady, worship God and hold to this Dharma.
units.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Oh my lady, worship God and hold to this Dharma.

units.text_roman: kaa3 aan1 tsaɯ2 sjn1 mɯn1 tsɯ3
units.lik_tai: ၵႃႈ ဢႃၼ် ၸႇ ꩢၼ် မိုၼ် ၸိုႈ
units.assamese_script: কা³ আন¹ চ² সন¹ মুন¹ চু³
units.translation: There are so many many minds to be read.
units.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: There are so many many minds to be read.

units.text_roman: nai3 k3 hit1 naang2 tsaɯ2 maɯ2 naang2 tang1
units.lik_tai: ၼႆႈ ၵႈ ႁိတ် ၼႃင်ႇ ၸႇ မႇ ၼႃင်ႇ တင်
units.assamese_script: নাই³ ক³ হিত্‌¹ নাঙ² চ² ম² নাঙ² তাঙ¹
units.translation: This, Oh my lady, makes your mind ...

units.text_roman: na1 ta1 phak1
units.lik_tai: ၼႃ တႃ ၽၵ်
units.assamese_script: না¹ তা¹ ফাক্‌¹

units.text_roman: maɯ2 naang2 khjn2 waai1 tang1 naa3 maa2 khaan1 khuu1

units.assamese_script: ম² নাঙ² খন² ৱাই¹ তাঙ¹ না³ মা² খান¹ খ¹

units.text_roman: khaam2 nii2 sii1 tsuu3 sɯn1 sɯn1 ta1

units.assamese_script: খাম² ন² স¹ চ³ সুন¹ সুন¹ তা¹
units.translation: Good and beautiful words, the words of Dharma.

units.notes: * In reading it, Nabin stated sEnqyEnqt;r; s*n Y*n ta1 raa2. When the translation was revised in March 2002, Nabin stated that it might be as follows

units.text_roman: kau2 tak1 lau2 maɯ2 naang2 hit1 ruu3 ki3 saɯ1 naang2 ɯi2
units.lik_tai: ၵဝ်ႇ တၵ် လဝ်ႇ မႇ ၼႃင်ႇ ႁိတ် ရႈ ၵိႈ ꩢ ၼႃင်ႇ ဢိုႆႇ
units.assamese_script: কাও² তাক্‌¹ লাও² ম² নাঙ² হিত্‌¹ ৰ³ কি³ স¹ নাঙ² অুই²
units.translation: I will tell, I will explain to you, my lady.
units.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: I will tell, I will explain to you, my lady.

units.text_roman: an2 waa2 khaam2 nui3 mɯng2 kuu2 nai3 k3 sii1 lak1
units.lik_tai: ဢၼ်ႇ ဝႃႇ ၶႃမ်ႇ ၼုႆႈ မိုင်ႇ ၵႇ ၼႆႈ ၵႈ ꩢ လၵ်
units.assamese_script: অন² ৱা² খাম² নুই³ মুঙ² ক² নাই³ ক³ স¹ লাক্‌¹
units.translation: Those words for the people of this earth...
units.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Those words for the people of this earth...

units.text_roman: kau2 tsau3 tak1 lau2 haɯ2 naang2 nai3
units.lik_tai: ၵဝ်ႇ ၸဝ်ႈ တၵ် လဝ်ႇ ႁႇ ၼႃင်ႇ ၼႆႈ
units.assamese_script: কাও² চাও³ তাক্‌¹ লাও² হ² নাঙ² নাই³

units.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: I will relate and tell for you, lady, to hear.
units.notes: Both the words l] and h] are spelled with the same final, possibly suggesting a vowel merge in Ahom at the time of the writing of this manuscript.

units.text_roman: naang2 tsang1 waai1 naa3 tang3 naa3
units.lik_tai: ၼႃင်ႇ ၸင် ဝႃႆ ၼႃႈ တင်ႈ ၼႃႈ
units.assamese_script: নাঙ² চাঙ¹ ৱাই¹ না³ তাঙ³ না³
units.translation: (What is) win1?
units.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: (What is) win1?

units.text_roman: maa2 khan1
units.lik_tai: မႃႇ ၶၼ်
units.assamese_script: মা² খান¹
units.translation: maa2 khan1 means 'come quickly'.
units.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: maa2 khan1 means 'come quickly'.

units.text_roman: phum1 sng1 tin2 nk3 tsau3
units.lik_tai: ၽုမ် ꩢင် တိၼ်ႇ ၼၵ်ႈ ၸဝ်ႈ
units.assamese_script: ফুম¹ সঙ¹ তিন² নক্‌³ চাও³
units.translation: Um, at that time, to bow the head and pray to the Lord.
units.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Um, at that time, to bow the head and pray to the Lord.

units.text_roman: kau2 khun1 tak1 lau2 khaam2 tɯ2 ta1 ta1
units.lik_tai: ၵဝ်ႇ ၶုၼ် တၵ် လဝ်ႇ ၶႃမ်ႇ တိုႇ တႃ တႃ
units.assamese_script: কাও² খুন¹ তাক্‌¹ লাও² খাম² তু² তা¹ তা¹
units.translation: Then that respected person said "I will teach the words of Dharma, the words of the teaching.
units.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Then that respected person said "I will teach the words of Dharma, the words of the teaching.

units.text_roman: haɯ3 naang2 ruu3 sjn1 sing1 ta1
units.lik_tai: ႁႈ ၼႃင်ႇ ရႈ ꩢၼ် ꩢိင် တႃ
units.assamese_script: হ³ নাঙ² ৰ³ সন¹ সিঙ¹ তা¹
units.translation: So that the lady may know the many sounds of the Dharma, think oh Lady!
units.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: So that the lady may know the many sounds of the Dharma, think oh Lady!
units.notes: Nabin read as [pha*1], but it seems to be clearly y].

units.text_roman: tang1 nii2 tang1 kin2 k3 mau1 tsut3 raai1
units.lik_tai: တင် ၼႇ တင် ၵိၼ်ႇ ၵႈ မဝ် ၸုတ်ႈ ရႃႆ
units.assamese_script: তাঙ¹ ন² তাঙ¹ কিন² ক³ মাও¹ চুত্‌³ ৰাই¹
units.translation: All is good, there is much to eat, there is no poverty.
units.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: All is good, there is much to eat, there is no poverty.

full_translation: Blessings. Dear lady, please turn your face, with a smile and laugh. There are four types of the good words of Dharma. I will tell you, my lady, so that you may know them and put them in (your mind), oh lady! I will tell these words for the whole earth, for all the four parts, oh my lady. I will tell so that you can listen. Lady, turn your face and gaze. Come quickly. From top to toe we make our prayers. I will tell the words of Dharma. So that the lady may know the many sounds of the Dharma, think oh Lady! (For in this Dharma), all is good, there is much to eat, and none are poor. Of all the things which are offered to eat, do not choose, but take all. Both day and night I reach reach towards God, towards Dharma and the teaching. All of this should be taken, don't just read it, put it into your mind. Allow (the Dharma) to touch all of your body, Oh Lady! Let the good come and do not speak words of complaint. Oh lady, you should not ask for the help of spirits, you should not let bad things enter your mind. All types of bad action, oh lady, you should not do. Do not speak jealous words, oh Lady! Do not speaking abusive or fighting words, and do not complain. Words of censuring others like this should not be spoken, oh my Lady! Though bad words may come, oh Lady, leave them aside every day. If someone does wrong, oh lady, think well. Don't do anything destructive, oh lady! Every day, Oh lady, you should think and speak diamond words, listen, oh my Lady! Oh you lady, how will you remain cool (headed)? If, oh my lady, you hold all the words of Dharma and do not release them, it will be good, oh Lady! You should look at and read the words of Dharma, all of them, oh Lady. Oh, it will be good, my Lady, if you catch (this Dharma). If you take the words of Dharma, do not release them. Put them clearly in your mind, without blemish. Like the water of many river, (the Dharma) will flow into your mind, like a clear spirit. Those many people who (accept the Dharma) will be as bathed in it many times, oh good lady. Oh my lady, do not pray to the spirits, and all will become clear. Oh my lady, worship God and hold to this Dharma. There are so many many minds to be read. This, Oh my lady, makes your mind ... Blessings. Keep smiling ... Good and beautiful words, the words of Dharma. I will tell, I will explain to you, my lady. Those words for the people of this earth... I will relate and tell for you, lady, to hear. (What is) win1? maa2 khan1 means 'come quickly'. Um, at that time, to bow the head and pray to the Lord. Then that respected person said "I will teach the words of Dharma, the words of the teaching. So that the lady may know the many sounds of the Dharma, think oh Lady! All is good, there is much to eat, there is no poverty.
title: Traditional Tai Wisdom and Counsel to Noble Daughters
